61K likes, 832 comments - unfitofit_official_ on February 7, 2025: "Aaj logo ki baari jo kahe keh lene de 
Tera bhi din ayega us din hisab chukake rehna ( hisab chukadia bayaj samet ) 

Politics in sports is what kills an athlete , i’ve faced this shit since so many years but today my performance is slap to all those who do injustice in sports . Never ever take me granted as an athlete , as a women , as a competitor.

I know there is soooo much hate against me ( just because i am doing better ) , hate me as much as you can i am still gonna shine ✨.

Thanks to all the coaches who were by my side , always grateful 🙏♾️♥️

On to the next ….. 🚶‍♀️ 

#champion #titlebelt #goldmedal #nevergiveup #dangal #kickboxing".
